full_list.title_en: Mechanical control of competing magnetic order in crystalline MnPtGa membranes
full_list.title_zh: 晶体 MnPtGa 薄膜中的竞争磁序的机械调控
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.12425v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: MnPtGa hosts competing magnetic states, including ferromagnetic, canted antiferromagnetic, and spin density wave (SDW) order in the centrosymmetric P6₃/mmc structure, while a related inversion-broken structure supports chiral skyrmions. Controlling this competition motivates materials platforms that enable tunable strain and symmetry breaking, together with probes of SDW order compatible with ultrathin samples. Here, we demonstrate single crystalline MnPtGa membranes grown by molecular beam epitaxy on graphene/Ge(111) and released by mechanical exfoliation. X-ray and electron diffraction confirm high crystalline quality. SQUID magnetometry reveals a 140 K anomaly in the zero-field-cooled dM/dT that persists after exfoliation, while time-resolved reflectivity shows a coincident peak in the electronic relaxation time consistent with a quasiparticle phonon bottleneck associated with a putative SDW gap. Intentional rippling suppresses the sim 140 K magnetic anomaly, demonstrating mechanical control of the low-temperature state. These results establish MnPtGa membranes as a platform for detecting and strain-tuning competing magnetic orders.
full_list.abstract_zh: MnPtGa 在中心对称的 P63/mmc 结构中具有铁磁、倾斜反铁磁和自旋密度波等竞争磁态，而相关的破缺反演对称结构则支持手性斯格明子。研究制备了生长于石墨烯/Ge(111)上的单晶 MnPtGa 薄膜，并通过机械剥离释放薄膜；衍射结果证实其具有较高晶体质量。磁化率和时间分辨反射率测量表明约 140 K 的异常与可能的自旋密度波能隙有关，而人为引入褶皱能够抑制该异常，显示出机械调控低温磁态的能力。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: MnPtGa 在中心对称的 P63/mmc 结构中具有相互竞争的磁性态，包括铁磁序、倾斜反铁磁序和自旋密度波（SDW）序，而一种相关的破缺反演对称结构则支持手性斯格明子。对这种竞争进行调控，需要能够实现可调应变和对称性破缺的材料平台，同时还需要适用于超薄样品的 SDW 序探测手段。在这里，我们展示了通过分子束外延在石墨烯/Ge(111)上生长、并通过机械剥离释放的单晶 MnPtGa 薄膜。X 射线和电子衍射证实了其较高的晶体质量。SQUID 磁强计测量显示，在零场冷却条件下，dM/dT 中位于 140 K 的异常在剥离后仍然存在，而时间分辨反射率测量显示，电子弛豫时间在同一温度处出现峰值，这与可能由假定的 SDW 能隙引起的准粒子—声子瓶颈相一致。人为引入褶皱会抑制约 140 K 的磁性异常，证明机械作用能够控制低温态。这些结果确立了 MnPtGa 薄膜作为探测和通过应变调控竞争磁序的平台。

full_list.title_en: Altermagnetism and Superconductivity: A Short Historical Review
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Altermagnetism and Superconductivity: A Short Historical Review
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2510.09170v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: This review is organized into three parts. In the first part, we explore the deep interconnections among three seemingly unrelated concepts in condensed matter physics: electronic liquid crystal phases, multipole expansions, and altermagnetism. At the heart of these phenomena lies a shared foundation: spin-momentum locking in the nonrelativistic regime. Originally proposed in the context of electronic liquid crystal phases, nonrelativistic spin-momentum locking was later elegantly incorporated into the formalism of multipole expansions. This framework can be further extended across multiple atomic sites, making it particularly effective for describing altermagnets, which host localized magnetic moments with anisotropic magnetization densities distributed over sublattices. In the second part, we examine superconducting phenomena associated with altermagnetism from three complementary perspectives. First, we investigate superconductivity associated with nonrelativistic spin-momentum locked Fermi surfaces, the unifying theme of the first part, highlighting a rich variety of unconventional superconducting states. These include finite-momentum pairing, d-wave and spin-triplet superconductivity, and topological Bogoliubov Fermi surfaces, among others. We then review superconductivity emerging from either static altermagnetic order or altermagnetic fluctuations. Finally, we discuss the possible competition and intertwining between altermagnetic order and superconductivity, illustrated using the repulsive Hubbard model. Additional related topics are addressed in the concluding part. Overall, this work offers both an accessible introduction to the newly identified magnetic order known as altermagnetism and a conceptual guide for researchers aiming to harness the ensuing unconventional superconductivity in the development of future quantum technologies.
full_list.summary: 该综述梳理交替磁性与超导之间的历史联系，讨论电子液晶相、多极展开、非相对论自旋-动量锁定和交替磁体之间的统一框架。文章进一步总结交替磁性背景下可能出现的非常规超导态和相关费米面物理。

full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Magnetic Skyrmion Interacting with Optical Skyrmion》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Intrinsic excitations and a proposed ground state in an Ammann-Beenker artificial spin ice
full_list.title_zh: Ammann-Beenker 人工自旋冰中的内禀激发与一种拟议基态
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.12930v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Artificial spin ices built on quasiperiodic geometries remain under-explored. Here we investigate an ASI based on the octagonal Ammann-Beenker tiling, whose six vertex types present local environments inaccessible in periodic lattices. Combining Monte Carlo simulations of dipolar-coupled macrospins with micromagnetic calculations of individual vertex energies, we find that vertex types freeze in an order set not by coordination number, but by quasi-degenerate levels at five-island vertices and their local environment. Excitations in the low energy state are correspondingly localised to specific, geometrically determined sites. Using twice-inflated substitution rules as an energetic backbone, we propose an analytical ground state combining a long-range ordered fixed spin network with a sparse set of degenerate regions.
full_list.abstract_zh: 该研究考察基于八角 Ammann-Beenker 拼砌的准周期人工自旋冰，其六种顶点类型提供了周期晶格中不存在的局域环境。作者结合偶极耦合宏自旋的 Monte Carlo 模拟和单个顶点能量的微磁计算，发现顶点冻结顺序并非由配位数决定，而由五岛顶点处的准简并能级及其局域环境决定。研究还提出一种解析基态，由长程有序的固定自旋网络与稀疏简并区域共同构成。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 建立在准周期几何上的人工自旋冰仍然研究不足。本文研究一种基于八角 Ammann-Beenker 拼砌的人工自旋冰，其六种顶点类型呈现出周期晶格中无法获得的局域环境。通过结合偶极耦合宏自旋的 Monte Carlo 模拟与单个顶点能量的微磁计算，我们发现顶点类型的冻结顺序并不由配位数决定，而是由五岛顶点处的准简并能级及其局域环境决定。低能态中的激发相应地局域在特定的、由几何决定的位置。利用二次膨胀替换规则作为能量骨架，我们提出了一种解析基态，它结合了长程有序的固定自旋网络和一组稀疏的简并区域。

full_list.title_en: Revealing Hidden Inversion Symmetry Breaking in ZrTe₅ via Phonon-Assisted Heterodyne Amplification
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Revealing Hidden Inversion Symmetry Breaking in ZrTe₅ via Phonon-Assisted Heterodyne Amplification
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.12359v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: ZrTe₅ is a sensitive topological material where small perturbations can alter its electronic structure. Its equilibrium crystal structure has been widely regarded as centrosymmetric, while recent experiments have raised the possibility of inversion-symmetry breaking. Here we probe this hidden symmetry lowering using nonlinear optical spectroscopy. Although conventional second-harmonic generation does not resolve an equilibrium symmetry-breaking signal, terahertz-field-induced second-harmonic generation (TFISH) reveals it through phonon-assisted heterodyne amplification. A coherently driven infrared-active phonon acts as a local oscillator for the vanishingly weak second-order susceptibility χ⁽²⁾, converting an otherwise undetectable symmetry-breaking response into a phonon-frequency modulation of the TFISH signal. The field-linear scaling of this modulation demonstrates χ⁽²⁾ is an equilibrium susceptibility rather than a response induced by the THz field. Polarization- and temperature-dependent measurements identify a bulk polar distortion along the crystallographic a axis that persists to room temperature, while the c axis remains nonpolar. These results provide direct optical evidence for equilibrium inversion-symmetry breaking in bulk ZrTe₅ and establish a structural constraint for understanding its electronic and topological properties.
full_list.summary: 论文利用太赫兹场诱导二次谐波和声子辅助异频放大，探测ZrTe5中常规二次谐波难以识别的隐藏反演对称性破缺。研究表明，红外活性声子可放大微弱的二阶非线性响应，并指向沿晶体a轴的体极性畸变。
full_list.focus_summary: 论文利用太赫兹场诱导二次谐波和声子辅助异频放大，探测ZrTe5中常规二次谐波难以识别的隐藏反演对称性破缺。研究表明，红外活性声子可放大微弱的二阶非线性响应，并指向沿晶体a轴的体极性畸变。

full_list.focus_suggestion: 可通过第一性原理计算和非线性光学响应计算验证ZrTe5的极性结构、声子模式及二阶极化率。进一步可研究声子驱动的瞬态反演对称性破缺对拓扑表面态和载流子动力学的影响。

full_list.title_en: Unconventional anisotropic charge dynamics in bulk 1T-TaS₂ induced by interlayer dimerization
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Unconventional anisotropic charge dynamics in bulk 1T-TaS₂ induced by interlayer dimerization
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2512.23883v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The commensurate charge-density-wave phase of the prototypical transition metal dichalcogenide 1T-TaS₂ is investigated by temperature- and polarization-dependent infrared spectroscopy, revealing distinct charge dynamics parallel and perpendicular to the layers. Supported by density-functional-theory calculations, we show that the in-plane electronic structure in the low-temperature commensurate phase is reconstructed by the sqrt13×sqrt13 distortion of the Ta layers. In contrast, the out-of-plane response is governed by a quasi-one-dimensional, Peierls-like dimerization of the two-dimensional star-of-David layers. Our results identify this dimerization as the dominant mechanism of the metal-to-insulator transition in both directions, ruling out a significant role of electronic correlations.
full_list.summary: 论文通过温度和偏振依赖的红外光谱结合密度泛函理论，研究1T-TaS2电荷密度波相中的各向异性电荷动力学。结果表明，层内响应主要由星形畸变重构，而层间响应由准一维的层间二聚化主导，并认为该二聚化是金属-绝缘体转变的关键机制。

full_list.title_en: An Exact Formulation of Phase-Space Electronic Structure Theory in One Dimension by Exploiting the Zero Curvature Condition
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：An Exact Formulation of Phase-Space Electronic Structure Theory in One Dimension by Exploiting the Zero Curvature Condition
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.13120v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that, for the unique case of a system of electrons and nuclei in one dimension, the Γ operator in phase space electronic structure theory has a zero non-Abelian curl. Using this fact, we are able to show that a phase space electronic structure framework in Wigner space has a one-to-one mapping to the exact fully quantum vibronic Hamiltonian. In other words, one loses no information by working within the framework of phase space electronic structure theory rather than Born-Huang theory; the only difference is that, whereas Born-Huang theory represents the total vibronic Hamiltonian as a quadratic order expansion in hbar, the Hamiltonian becomes an infinite order expansion in hbar within a phase space electronic structure framework (a so-called "Generalized Born-Huang" approach). That being said, numerical results at first or second order demonstrate that, for a limited number of electronic states, phase space electronic structure theory strongly outperforms Born-Huang theory - a result that justifies a great deal more research into this novel electronic structure approach.
full_list.summary: 论文提出一维体系中相空间电子结构理论的精确表述，利用零曲率条件建立其与完整量子振电哈密顿量之间的一一映射。数值结果显示，在有限电子态数下，一阶或二阶近似可能优于传统Born-Huang展开。
full_list.focus_summary: 论文提出一维体系中相空间电子结构理论的精确表述，利用零曲率条件建立其与完整量子振电哈密顿量之间的一一映射。数值结果显示，在有限电子态数下，一阶或二阶近似可能优于传统Born-Huang展开。
full_list.focus_relation: 与团队的电子结构计算、非绝热分子动力学、电子-声子耦合和激发态量子动力学存在方法学联系。其相空间哈密顿量表述可为研究载流子弛豫、热载流子动力学和振电耦合提供新的理论工具，但目前局限于一维体系。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 建议评估该方法向二维材料、缺陷半导体和卤化物钙钛矿中的推广可能性，尤其关注非绝热耦合和声子重整化。可将其与时间依赖密度泛函理论、非绝热分子动力学及机器学习哈密顿量结合。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《An Exact Formulation of Phase-Space Electronic Structure Theory in One Dimension by Exploiting the Zero Curvature Condition》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Emergent magnetism, heavy electrons and pressure-induced reentrant superconductivity in the iron substituted 4d transition-metal sulfides
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Emergent magnetism, heavy electrons and pressure-induced reentrant superconductivity in the iron substituted 4d transition-metal sulfides
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.12351v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Superconductivity emerging from or in the vicinity of magnetic states is generally considered to be mediated by spin fluctuations and thus lies beyond the scope of conventional electron-phonon coupled BCS framework. Here we report the emergence of novel ferromagnetism in the d-electron rhodium sulfide Rh17S15 superconductor, characterized by an enhanced Sommerfeld coefficient γ arising from the flat topological band and many-body correlations. We further demonstrate that the ferromagnetism can be tuned via Fe substitution at the Rh sites, leading to a spin glass ground state induced by the competing ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic exchange interactions. Fe doping results in a further enhancement of both the γ and electron effective masses. At a doping level of x = 0.67 in Rh17-xFexS15, γ reaches 312 mJ mol-1K-2, second only to the well-documented d-electron heavy-fermion material LiV2O4. Furthermore, upon applying pressure, superconductivity is first suppressed; under high pressures, however, we observe the reentrant superconductivity in both pristine and Fe-doped samples. Our results not only demonstrate the unusual magnetic states and possible heavy-fermion features in these frustration-free, d-based superconductors, but also suggest that the superconductivity in this system is likely mediated by the intrinsic spin fluctuations and may thus be unconventional.
full_list.summary: 研究铁取代硫化铑体系中的磁性、重费米子行为和压力诱导的再入超导。结果表明，铁掺杂可引发自旋玻璃态、增强电子有效质量，并在高压下出现再入超导。
full_list.focus_summary: 研究铁取代硫化铑体系中的磁性、重费米子行为和压力诱导的再入超导。结果表明，铁掺杂可引发自旋玻璃态、增强电子有效质量，并在高压下出现再入超导。
full_list.focus_relation: 与我们的磁性材料、超导、电子关联和自旋相互作用方向相关。可借鉴其铁掺杂调控磁交换竞争与超导的思路，进一步用第一性原理、有效自旋哈密顿量和蒙特卡洛方法解析其磁性起源。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 建议计算不同铁占位和磁构型下的交换参数、电子结构及压力依赖性，并研究磁涨落与电子-声子耦合对再入超导的共同作用。可重点关注平带、重费米子行为与拓扑磁性之间的联系。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：电子—声子耦合与输运，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。

full_list.title_en: Nonequilibrium Quasiparticle Effects on Domain Wall Dynamics in Superconductors
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Nonequilibrium Quasiparticle Effects on Domain Wall Dynamics in Superconductors
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.12570v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the dynamics of a domain wall (DW) in a type-II superconductor connected to two heat reservoirs. We employ a generalized time-dependent Ginzburg--Landau framework in which the superconducting order parameter and the nonequilibrium quasiparticle distribution are treated as coupled dynamical variables. Within this framework, the effect of the thermal bias is imposed through boundary conditions on the quasiparticle distribution, which are set by the reservoir temperatures. We show, both numerically and within linear response, that the DW moves toward the hotter boundary. From the local momentum-balance relation implied by the model, we identify a viscous force and a force arising from the coupling between the order parameter and the nonequilibrium distribution function. The nonequilibrium distribution separates exactly into a boundary-driven part and a part generated by the motion of the DW itself. The former sets the sign of the DW velocity, whereas the latter renormalizes the relaxation of the order parameter. These results provide a microscopic basis for the phenomenological local-temperature description developed in our previous work.
full_list.summary: 本文在广义含时Ginzburg-Landau框架下研究连接两个热库的II型超导体中超导畴壁的非平衡动力学，并将序参量与准粒子分布作为耦合动力学变量。结果表明，温度偏置驱动畴壁向高温边界运动，局部动量平衡中同时出现黏滞力和序参量—准粒子分布耦合产生的力。
full_list.focus_summary: 本文在广义含时Ginzburg-Landau框架下研究连接两个热库的II型超导体中超导畴壁的非平衡动力学，并将序参量与准粒子分布作为耦合动力学变量。结果表明，温度偏置驱动畴壁向高温边界运动，局部动量平衡中同时出现黏滞力和序参量—准粒子分布耦合产生的力。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。

full_list.title_en: Orbital-geometric spin response: inter-band coherence versus orbital-to-spin conversion
full_list.title_zh: 轨道几何自旋响应：能带间相干与轨道到自旋的转换
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.12093v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Orbitronics seeks to convert orbital angular momentum (OAM) into spin, but its microscopic dynamics is not understood. Here I show that, at moderate spin-orbit coupling, an electrically induced spin density contains a direct term and an orbital-geometric spin response (OGSR) due to inter-band coherence of the spinless parent Hamiltonian---related to OAM but not descended from it. In massive Dirac fermions the OGSR survives as the net OAM vanishes, and generates counterflow, opposing the direct response. These results provide guidelines for optimising orbitronic systems.
full_list.abstract_zh: 研究表明，在中等自旋轨道耦合下，电场诱导的自旋密度包含直接项和轨道几何自旋响应，后者源于无自旋母哈密顿量的能带间相干，虽与轨道角动量有关，却并非由其直接转化而来。在有质量 Dirac 费米子中，即使净轨道角动量为零，该响应仍然存在，并可产生与直接响应方向相反的反向流。研究结果为优化轨道电子学体系提供了指导。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 轨道电子学旨在将轨道角动量转换为自旋，但其微观动力学尚未得到理解。在这里，我表明，在中等自旋轨道耦合下，电场诱导的自旋密度包含一个直接项和一个轨道几何自旋响应。后者源于无自旋母哈密顿量的能带间相干，与轨道角动量有关，但并非由轨道角动量转化而来。在有质量 Dirac 费米子中，即使净轨道角动量为零，轨道几何自旋响应仍然存在，并产生与直接响应相反的反向流。这些结果为优化轨道电子学系统提供了指导。
full_list.summary: 研究表明，在中等自旋轨道耦合下，电场诱导的自旋密度包含直接项和轨道几何自旋响应，后者源于无自旋母哈密顿量的能带间相干，虽与轨道角动量有关，却并非由其直接转化而来。在有质量 Dirac 费米子中，即使净轨道角动量为零，该响应仍然存在，并可产生与直接响应方向相反的反向流。研究结果为优化轨道电子学体系提供了指导。
full_list.focus_summary: 论文研究轨道电子学中的电致自旋响应，将其分解为直接响应和源于无自旋母哈密顿量能带间相干的轨道几何自旋响应。在具有质量的狄拉克费米子体系中，轨道几何响应即使在净轨道角动量为零时仍然存在，并可能与直接响应反向竞争。

full_list.title_en: Fermi arcs for generic nodal points hosting monopoles or dipoles
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Fermi arcs for generic nodal points hosting monopoles or dipoles
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2510.18785v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Surface-localised states in the form of Fermi arcs emerge at the interfaces between three-dimensional topological semimetals and their surrounding vacuum, serving as primary signatures of momentum-space topology accessible to modern spectroscopic methods. These arcs encode information about topological singularities --- nodal points where multiple bands converge --- through their geometric properties. Specifically, the arcs terminate tangentially at the edges of Fermi-surface projections, delineating where surface modes transition into bulk extended states. The arcs' multiplicity at each node corresponds directly to the underlying topological charge (Berry-curvature monopole magnitude), thereby offering a window into momentum-space invariants via angle-resolved photoemission experiments. This work establishes a systematic framework for computing surface state configurations applicable to arbitrary nodal degeneracies and band dispersions: (1) nodes with twofold through multifold band multiplicities; and (2) bands exhibiting diverse momentum-dependence patterns, including linear, nonlinear, isotropic, and anisotropic regimes. We additionally examine topologically distinct nodal types where monopole charges vanish but dipolar Berry-curvature distributions appear, clarifying the surface-state landscape in such unconventional scenarios.

full_list.title_en: Density-matrix quantum kinetics of spin-mode crossover and ac Edelstein response in spin--orbit-coupled chiral metals
full_list.title_zh: 自旋-轨道耦合手性金属中自旋模交叉与交流 Edelstein 响应的密度矩阵量子动力学
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.12936v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: To establish a reference for angular-momentum dynamics driven by spin--orbit coupling (SOC) in chiral conductors, we formulate a density-matrix quantum kinetic theory for a three-dimensional isotropic chiral metal with hedgehog SOC and nonmagnetic impurity scattering. The formulation retains interband coherence, and its collision integral conserves charge, energy, and spin during impurity scattering. We identify three spin modes that evolve continuously from a long-lived D'yakonov--Perel' relaxation mode and two strongly damped precessional modes at weak SOC to one relaxational and two coherent precessional modes at strong SOC. Comparison with a band-diagonal Boltzmann equation shows that interband coherence is essential for both the weak-SOC relaxation mode and the strong-SOC precessional modes. We further derive the ac Edelstein susceptibility and the reciprocal current response to a time-dependent Zeeman field, show that their poles coincide with the spin modes, and verify Onsager reciprocity. The theory thus provides a unified analytic description of spin relaxation, precession, and spin--charge conversion across the weak-to-strong SOC crossover.
full_list.abstract_zh: 该研究建立了三维各向同性手性金属的密度矩阵量子动力学理论，用于描述由自旋-轨道耦合驱动的角动量动力学。理论保留带间相干性，并构造了在杂质散射中守恒电荷、能量和自旋的碰撞积分。作者识别出随 SOC 强度从弱到强连续演化的三种自旋模，并推导交流 Edelstein 磁化率及其倒易电流响应，验证了 Onsager 倒易性。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 为了为手性导体中由自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）驱动的角动量动力学建立一个参考，我们为具有刺猬型 SOC 和非磁性杂质散射的三维各向同性手性金属构建了密度矩阵量子动力学理论。该形式保留了带间相干性，并且其碰撞积分在杂质散射过程中守恒电荷、能量和自旋。我们识别出三种自旋模，它们从弱 SOC 下的一个长寿命 D'yakonov-Perel' 弛豫模和两个强阻尼进动模，连续演化为强 SOC 下的一个弛豫模和两个相干进动模。与带对角 Boltzmann 方程的比较表明，带间相干性对于弱 SOC 弛豫模和强 SOC 进动模都是必不可少的。我们进一步推导了交流 Edelstein 磁化率以及对含时 Zeeman 场的倒易电流响应，表明它们的极点与自旋模一致，并验证了 Onsager 倒易性。因此，该理论为跨越弱到强 SOC 交叉的自旋弛豫、进动和自旋-电荷转换提供了统一的解析描述。

full_list.title_en: Magnon-induced hybridization brightens excitons in ferromagnetic semiconductors
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Magnon-induced hybridization brightens excitons in ferromagnetic semiconductors
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.13124v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Excitons in magnetic semiconductors have energies and spin structures that are sensitive to the underlying magnetic order. We study this coupling in a minimal one-dimensional lattice model of a conduction electron and a valence hole moving in a ferromagnetic background of localized quantum spins, treating the electron, the hole, and the magnon(s) as explicitly resolved degrees of freedom. At zero temperature, spin conservation closes the relevant Hilbert subspaces at the one- or two-magnon level, so the model can be solved essentially exactly with a real-space Green's function method. Comparison against a frozen-spin approximation in which the local moments are replaced by their ordered values identifies which effects are due to emission and absorption of quantum magnons. A frozen background already lifts the spin degeneracy of the exciton and, if the two carriers couple with different strengths to the local moments, it mixes the singlet with the spin-zero triplet exciton. The emission and absorption of quantum magnons goes qualitatively further: it splits and shifts the exciton energies nonlinearly in the exchange coupling even when all frozen-spin effects vanish; for carriers with unequal hopping integrals, it hybridizes the singlet and spin-zero triplet excitons, thereby brightening the dark triplet; and it increases the exciton radius, which in turn enhances the magnon dressing by removing an on-site cancellation. These quantum effects are therefore strongest for extended, Wannier-like excitons, which is precisely the regime that is commonly modeled assuming a static (frozen-spin) magnetic order.

full_list.title_en: Diagonal Pair Coulomb Density Matrix on a Sphere: a numerical study
full_list.title_zh: 球面上的对角线成对库仑密度矩阵：数值研究
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.11984v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We tabulate, on the diagonal, the nth power of the primitive approximation for the pair Coulomb density matrix on a sphere, with up to n=5, and we discuss its behavior at particles contact as n grows. Our results show that even on a curved surface quantum statistical physics is fundamentally different from its classical counterpart. If in the latter one needs to artificially introduce a regularization of the divergent attractive Coulomb potential preventing particles contact, for example with a hard core, in the former this is not necessary.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文在球面上对成对库仑密度矩阵的原始近似的幂次进行了对角线数值列表整理，最高达到n=5，并讨论了随着n增大其在粒子接触处的行为。结果表明，即使在曲面上，量子统计物理也与经典对应物存在根本差异；经典情况下需要人为引入硬核等正则化来阻止粒子接触，而量子情况下则不需要这样做。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们在对角线上列出了球面上成对库仑密度矩阵的原始近似的第n次幂，最高达到n=5，并讨论了随着n增大该矩阵在粒子接触处的行为。我们的结果表明，即使在曲面上，量子统计物理也与其经典对应物存在根本差异。在经典情况下，人们需要人为引入一种正则化，以防止具有发散吸引性库仑势的粒子发生接触，例如采用硬核；而在量子情况下，则没有必要这样做。

full_list.title_en: Pseudo-hybrid density functional ACBN0 for Hubbard U correction in a numeric atom-centered orbital basis
full_list.title_zh: 数值原子中心轨道基组中的 Hubbard U 修正赝杂化密度泛函 ACBN0
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.12198v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a formulation and implementation of the Agapito-Curtarolo-Buongiorno Nardelli (ACBN0) pseudo-hybrid density functional in a numeric atom-centered orbital basis. The method is realized in the all-electron, full-potential electronic-structure package FHI-aims. The implementation uses a Löwdin-orthogonalized projector, which improved the stability of the self-consistent ACBN0 iterations for the tested systems. For a benchmark set of materials including metal oxides and nitrides, ACBN0 with the fully localized limit (FLL) as the double-counting treatment reduces the aggregate band gap errors relative to the Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof (PBE) and strongly constrained and appropriately normed (SCAN) functionals, reaching an accuracy comparable to the Heyd-Scuseria-Ernzerhof functional (HSE06). For six bulk transition metal oxides calculated with the same numerical settings, an HSE06 iteration is approximately 13-33 times as expensive as the corresponding ACBN0@PBE iteration with Petukhov mixing. The applicability of the localized-basis implementation to low-dimensional systems is demonstrated by calculations of adsorption and the oxygen evolution reaction (OER) overpotential on a β-NiOOH(001) surface. On regularized SCAN (rSCAN) relaxed structures, single point ACBN0 based on rSCAN (ACBN0@rSCAN) with the ``tight'' numerical settings reduces the mean absolute deviation of the reaction-step energies from HSE06 and shifts the estimated overpotential toward the HSE06 and Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof hybrid (PBE0) reference results.
full_list.abstract_zh: 研究给出了适用于数值原子中心轨道基组的 ACBN0 赝杂化密度泛函公式，并将其实现于全电子全势电子结构软件 FHI-aims 中。采用 Löwdin 正交化投影器提高了自洽迭代的稳定性；对多种材料的基准测试表明，结合完全局域化极限双计数处理的 ACBN0 可显著改善带隙误差，精度接近 HSE06，而计算成本明显更低。对低维体系的应用也显示，该方法能够改进表面吸附和析氧反应过电势的预测。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出并实现了适用于数值原子中心轨道基组的 Agapito–Curtarolo–Buongiorno Nardelli（ACBN0）赝杂化密度泛函。该方法被实现于全电子、全势电子结构软件包 FHI-aims 中。该实现采用 Löwdin 正交化投影器，提高了所测试体系中 ACBN0 自洽迭代的稳定性。对于包括金属氧化物和氮化物在内的一组基准材料，采用完全局域化极限（FLL）作为双计数处理的 ACBN0，相较于 Perdew–Burke–Ernzerhof（PBE）和强约束且适当归一化（SCAN）泛函，降低了总体带隙误差，并达到了与 Heyd–Scuseria–Ernzerhof 泛函（HSE06）相当的精度。对于使用相同数值设置计算的六种块体过渡金属氧化物，采用 Petukhov 混合的 HSE06 迭代，其计算成本约为相应 ACBN0@PBE 迭代的 13–33 倍。通过计算 β-NiOOH(001) 表面的吸附和析氧反应（OER）过电势，展示了该局域基组实现对低维体系的适用性。在经过正则化 SCAN（rSCAN）弛豫的结构上，采用 rSCAN 的单点 ACBN0 计算（ACBN0@rSCAN）并使用紧致数值设置，可以降低反应步骤能量相对于 HSE06 的平均绝对偏差，并使估算的过电势向 HSE06 和 Perdew–Burke–Ernzerhof 杂化泛函（PBE0）的参考结果移动。

full_list.title_en: Tensor-network Monte Carlo approach based on time-evolving block decimation
full_list.title_zh: 基于时间演化块解耦的张量网络蒙特卡洛方法
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.12466v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a tensor-network Monte Carlo (TNMC) approach for unitary evolution following the compression sequence of the time-evolving block decimation (TEBD) algorithm. In the TNMC approach, the obtained results contain evaluable statistical errors rather than truncation errors, unlike ordinary singular-value-decomposition-based methods such as the TEBD algorithm. Consequently, one can estimate unbiased expectation values within statistical errors even with a finite bond dimension. Since the sampling scheme is introduced in the simulations of unitary evolution, the proposed Monte Carlo scheme may suffer from a sign problem. We observe that the sign problem can be mitigated by increasing the bond dimension. We apply the proposed TNMC approach to the Hamiltonian and the Floquet dynamics. Numerical experiments show that the TNMC approach can estimate accurate expectation values of observables even when the TEBD method with the same bond dimension cannot. The proposed approach can be a new direction for improving the classical simulatability of unitary evolution.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种张量网络蒙特卡洛方法，用于按照时间演化块解耦算法的压缩序列进行幺正演化。与基于奇异值分解的常规方法不同，该方法产生的是可评估的统计误差而非截断误差，因此即使键维数有限，也能在统计误差范围内估计无偏期望值。数值结果表明，在相同键维数下，该方法能够在时间演化块解耦方法失效时仍准确估计观测量，并可应用于哈密顿量动力学和Floquet动力学。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种张量网络蒙特卡洛方法，用于按照时间演化块解耦算法的压缩序列进行幺正演化。在张量网络蒙特卡洛方法中，所得结果包含可评估的统计误差，而不是像时间演化块解耦算法等基于奇异值分解的常规方法那样包含截断误差。因此，即使在有限键维数下，也可以在统计误差范围内估计无偏的期望值。由于采样方案被引入幺正演化的模拟中，所提出的蒙特卡洛方案可能遭遇符号问题。我们观察到，增大键维数可以减弱符号问题。我们将所提出的张量网络蒙特卡洛方法应用于哈密顿量动力学和Floquet动力学。数值实验表明，即使相同键维数下的时间演化块解耦方法无法做到这一点，张量网络蒙特卡洛方法仍能准确估计观测量的期望值。所提出的方法可以成为提高幺正演化经典可模拟性的新方向。

full_list.title_en: 2D Weak Localization in Trilayer Ruddelsden-Popper Nickelates
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：2D Weak Localization in Trilayer Ruddelsden-Popper Nickelates
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.13049v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ruddlesden-Popper (RP) nickelates superconduct when pressure suppresses intertwined charge- and spin-density waves. Here, we employ measurements of quantum corrections to magnetoconductivity as a probe of the dimensionality, phase coherence, and scattering mechanisms of the underlying single crystal trilayer RP nickelate Pr4Ni3O10 and La4Ni3O10. We observe signatures of 2D Weak Localization (WL), implying that the in-plane electron transport is in the quantum diffusive regime, while the out-of-plane transport is incoherent, and the electronic ground state is a quasi-2D disordered Fermi liquid. Application of pressure up to 3 GPa continuously suppresses signatures of WL, potentially signaling a 2D/3D dimensional crossover and an eventual pressure-driven transition into a superconductor.

full_list.title_en: Breakdown of Multipole Expansion in Emergent Electromagnetism
full_list.title_zh: 涌现电磁学中的多极展开失效
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.12063v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We find a striking departure from simple electrostatics in a family of two-dimensional lattice models whose effective description takes the form of an emergent electromagnetism: a high-order multipolar charge configuration can induce an electric field characteristic of a lower-order multipole. Studying the archetypical hardcore dimer and U(1) spin-1/2 link models, we trace this to a breakdown of the superposition principle: for dense charge configurations, there can be a nonlinear suppression, or even enhancement, of the far field compared to the linear expectation. Our work establishes that microscopic lattice-scale constraints in models for emergent electromagnetism can change the far-field behaviour to differ from often utilized long-wavelength descriptions in standard effective continuum models.
full_list.abstract_zh: 研究发现，在一类具有涌现电磁学有效描述的二维晶格模型中，高阶多极电荷构型可能产生具有低阶多极特征的电场。以硬核二聚体模型和 U(1) 自旋-1/2 链接模型为例，作者将其归因于叠加原理的失效：对于高密度电荷构型，远场相较线性预期可能受到非线性抑制，甚至得到增强。结果表明，晶格尺度的微观约束能够显著改变涌现电磁学的远场行为。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们在一类二维晶格模型中发现了对简单静电学的显著偏离，这些模型的有效描述具有涌现电磁学的形式：高阶多极电荷构型能够产生具有低阶多极特征的电场。通过研究典型的硬核二聚体模型和 U(1) 自旋-1/2 链接模型，我们将这一现象追溯到叠加原理的失效：对于高密度电荷构型，远场相较于线性预期可能出现非线性抑制，甚至增强。我们的工作表明，用于描述涌现电磁学的微观晶格尺度约束，能够改变远场行为，使其不同于标准有效连续模型中常用的长波长描述。
full_list.summary: 研究发现，在一类具有涌现电磁学有效描述的二维晶格模型中，高阶多极电荷构型可能产生具有低阶多极特征的电场。以硬核二聚体模型和 U(1) 自旋-1/2 链接模型为例，作者将其归因于叠加原理的失效：对于高密度电荷构型，远场相较线性预期可能受到非线性抑制，甚至得到增强。结果表明，晶格尺度的微观约束能够显著改变涌现电磁学的远场行为。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《涌现电磁学中的多极展开失效》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Chirality in Condensed Matter: Symmetry, Waves, and Quasiparticles
full_list.title_zh: 凝聚态物质中的手性：对称性、波与准粒子
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.12434v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chirality has become a recurring concept throughout condensed-matter physics, appearing in contexts ranging from optical activity and chiral phonons to magnetic excitations and hybrid quasiparticles. As its use has expanded, however, the concept has often become intertwined with related notions such as angular momentum, polarization, helicity, and nonreciprocity, obscuring its precise symmetry-based meaning. Although chirality is universally associated with broken spatial-inversion (P) symmetry and preserved time-reversal (T) symmetry, its physical manifestation and quantitative characterization strongly depend on the system and phenomenon under consideration. In this review, we examine chirality across photons, phonons, magnons, and hybrid excitations. We show that, while no universal measure of chirality exists, different physical systems admit different P-odd and T-even quantities that characterize specific chiral phenomena. We further argue that chirality is often best understood through chirality-selective interactions between waves, matter, and quasiparticles rather than as an intrinsic property of isolated excitations. From this perspective, hybridization provides a particularly promising setting for the emergence, transfer, and control of chirality in condensed-matter systems.
full_list.abstract_zh: 手性广泛存在于凝聚态物理的光学活性、手性声子、磁激发和混合准粒子等现象中，但其含义常与角动量、偏振、螺旋度和非互易性相混淆。本文从光子、声子、磁振子及混合激发的角度综述手性，指出不存在普适的手性度量，不同体系需采用特定的宇称奇、时间反演偶物理量进行刻画。作者认为，手性往往应通过波、物质与准粒子之间的手性选择性相互作用来理解，而非视为孤立激发的内禀性质；混成则为手性的产生、传递与调控提供了重要平台。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 手性已经成为贯穿凝聚态物理的一个反复出现的概念，涉及从光学活性和手性声子到磁激发与混合准粒子等一系列领域。然而，随着其应用范围不断扩大，这一概念常常与角动量、偏振、螺旋度和非互易性等相关概念交织在一起，从而模糊了其基于对称性的确切含义。尽管手性普遍与空间反演对称性破缺，即宇称对称性P破缺，以及时间反演对称性T保持联系在一起，但其物理表现和定量表征在很大程度上取决于所考察的体系和现象。在这篇综述中，我们考察了光子、声子、磁振子和混合激发中的手性。我们表明，虽然不存在统一的手性度量，但不同物理体系可以采用不同的宇称奇且时间反演偶的物理量，来表征特定的手性现象。我们进一步认为，与其把手性视为孤立激发的内禀性质，不如通过波、物质和准粒子之间的手性选择性相互作用来理解它。从这一角度看，混成是凝聚态体系中手性产生、传递和调控的一个尤其有前景的场景。

full_list.title_en: Enhanced anomalous Nernst effect in Pr-doped kagome and honeycomb magnet LaCo₅
full_list.title_zh: Pr掺杂Kagome与蜂窝磁体LaCo₅中的增强反常能斯特效应
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.12452v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work, we report the successful synthesis of La₁₋ₓPrₓCo₅ (x = 0.09, 0.21, 0.45) single crystals. Magnetic field-dependent magnetization measurements reveal that Pr substitution induces negligible changes in the magnetic properties of LaCo₅, with the ferromagnetic ordering predominantly governed by the Co sublattices. Remarkably, the doped systems exhibit significant enhancements in the anomalous Nernst effect. At 300~K, the anomalous Nernst thermopower S^Ayₓ reaches 6.5~μ V/K in La₀.₅₅Pr₀.₄₅Co₅, corresponding to a sim 40 % enhancement compared to the parent compound. This significant improvement can be predominantly attributed to Pr-doping-induced Fermi level modification, which directly leads to a redistribution of Berry curvature across the Fermi surface. This work highlights the effectiveness of Pr doping in boosting the anomalous Nernst effect of La₁₋ₓPrₓCo₅, offering a practical strategy to design advanced materials for room-temperature energy-harvesting technologies and high-efficiency thermal sensing devices.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文成功制备了La₁₋ₓPrₓCo₅（x = 0.09、0.21、0.45）单晶。磁场依赖的磁化测量表明，Pr替代对LaCo₅磁性的影响很小，铁磁有序主要由Co子晶格决定。掺杂体系的反常能斯特效应显著增强，在300 K时La₀.₅₅Pr₀.₄₅Co₅的反常能斯特热电势达到6.5 μV/K，较母体材料提高约40%。这种增强主要归因于Pr掺杂引起的费米能级调节及费米面上贝里曲率的重新分布。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 在本工作中，我们成功制备了La₁₋ₓPrₓCo₅（x = 0.09、0.21、0.45）单晶。磁场依赖的磁化测量显示，Pr替代对LaCo₅磁性性质的影响可以忽略，铁磁有序主要由Co子晶格控制。值得注意的是，掺杂体系表现出显著增强的反常能斯特效应。在300 K时，La₀.₅₅Pr₀.₄₅Co₅中的反常能斯特热电势S^A_yx达到6.5 μV/K，相比母体化合物提高了约40%。这种显著改善主要可归因于Pr掺杂诱导的费米能级调节，该调节直接导致费米面上贝里曲率的重新分布。本工作凸显了Pr掺杂在增强La₁₋ₓPrₓCo₅反常能斯特效应方面的有效性，并为设计用于室温能量收集技术和高效热传感器件的先进材料提供了实用策略。

full_list.title_en: The Battery Price of edge AI: A study of the Environmental Impact of LLM Inference on Mobile Devices
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：The Battery Price of edge AI: A study of the Environmental Impact of LLM Inference on Mobile Devices
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.11940v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The rapid diffusion of generative artificial intelligence raises privacy, latency, and performance concerns that motivate a shift toward "local-first" AI, where inferences are performed on the user's device instead of on remote cloud servers. This paradigm also places a significant computational load on battery-powered smartphones, potentially shortening battery life and increasing the overall replacement rate of mobile devices. This paper presents a systematic study of the energy consumption, performance, and accuracy of on-device large language model (LLM) inference. We evaluate 18 models from different model families, sizes, and quantization levels, on two modern smartphones and on a server, using the respective state-of-the-art for such deployments. We measure the energy per generated token, inter-token latency, model accuracy, and battery-cycle consumption. Our results show that (i) on-device inference is on average 3 times less energy-efficient than batched server inference; (ii) the relationship between quantization bit-width and energy per token is non-monotonic, with energy sweet spots on both tested smartphones; (iii) eight out of 18 model configurations lie on the Pareto front of accuracy and energy-efficiency, allowing practitioners to build battery-aware model routers; and (iv) realistic modeling assumptions do not allow local inference to be less environmentally impacting per token than batched server inference, with 88--90% of that impact attributable to device embodied carbon rather than electricity consumption. These findings challenge the premise that local AI is more sustainable than cloud inference, and motivate the need for context-aware and life-cycle-aware model selection when deploying edge AI on battery-powered mobile platforms.

full_list.title_en: HoliBench: A Cross-Platform Benchmarking and Deployment Toolkit for Foundation Models in CPS-IoT Applications
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：HoliBench: A Cross-Platform Benchmarking and Deployment Toolkit for Foundation Models in CPS-IoT Applications
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.12412v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Foundation models, including large language models, vision-language models, and time-series foundation models, are increasingly deployed on embedded and edge platforms for CPS and IoT applications, where energy, latency, and memory are as critical as task accuracy. Existing benchmarking tools evaluate model capability in isolation, reporting accuracy assuming sufficient compute, while hardware profiling tools remain platform-specific and mutually incompatible. As a result, users lack a unified workflow for making deployment decisions across heterogeneous devices. We present HoliBench, a modular benchmarking and deployment toolkit that jointly characterizes accuracy, latency, and energy across platforms from single-board computers to GPU servers. Its platform abstraction layer calibrates cross-device measurement, and the toolkit supports multiple model modalities, inference engines, concurrencies, and existing evaluation harnesses. An interactive interface exposes constraint-aware configuration selection over a design space that is profiled once and reused across studies. Using HoliBench, we characterize 20 models across 7 device types, 3 quantization levels, 8 inference backends, and over 30 tasks, surfacing tradeoffs that existing tools miss: quantization reduces latency only on hardware with low-precision support, accuracy gains show diminishing returns relative to energy, and for autoregressive workloads, average inference power is approximately constant across output lengths. We further find that single-model profiles compose under sequential co-resident execution. In a multi-model CPS deployment, standalone profiles predict combined-pipeline latency and power within 1.2% and 2.5%, enabling deployment exploration without exhaustively profiling every pipeline configuration. We release HoliBench as open-source infrastructure for deployment-aware evaluation of foundation models.

full_list.title_en: PLSP (Pre-hoc Liminal Space Profiling): OOD Prediction over Detection -- An Anticipatory Approach for Machine Learning Model Reliability
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：PLSP (Pre-hoc Liminal Space Profiling): OOD Prediction over Detection -- An Anticipatory Approach for Machine Learning Model Reliability
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.12225v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Out-of-Distribution (OOD) data poses a significant threat to machine learning models, often leading to model failure during deployment. All existing OOD detection methods are post-hoc, relying on evaluation metrics such as accuracy and AUC-ROC during inference to indirectly assess the model's response to OOD data by measuring deviations. In contrast to existing approaches, the proposed work shifts the paradigm from OOD detection to OOD prediction by proposing a pre-hoc anticipatory framework called PLSP for OOD prediction. We make several key contributions: (a) a dataset-independent metric called the CREDibility Score (CREDS) is proposed for OOD prediction; (b) credibility curves are introduced to study the maximum credibility a model can attain; and (c) credibility heat maps (and volume under surface) are introduced to characterize pre-hoc model behavior across different datasets. This work provides a novel perspective on signal processing under distributional shifts. Experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate that the proposed metric serves as a valuable measure for improving the robustness of machine learning models toward OOD prediction.

full_list.title_en: QTrans: A Quantum Transformer for Sentiment Classification
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：QTrans: A Quantum Transformer for Sentiment Classification
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.12011v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In small-scale binary sentiment classification scenarios, factors such as negation, contrastive shifts, and cross-word dependencies lead to the non-linear coupling of sentiment cues, making it difficult for conventional lightweight models to fully capture the contextual relationships between tokens. To address this issue, we propose a model named QTrans, which uses parameterized quantum circuits to construct query, key, and value features and derives attention coefficients from Gaussian distances between quantum measurements. By further integrating a quantum feed-forward neural network, residual connections, and layer normalization, the model establishes an end-to-end trainable quantum-classical hybrid framework for sentiment classification. Experimental results on the MR, CR, and MPQA datasets show that QTrans achieves test accuracies of 72.13%, 69.51%, and 63.45%, respectively, representing improvements of 2.88, 3.17, and 3.79 percentage points over the best-performing classical baselines for each dataset. Overall, QTrans expands the application of parameterized quantum circuits in lightweight sentiment analysis and lays an experimental foundation for further research into quantum multi-head self-attention for modeling textual relationships.

full_list.title_en: Machine Learning-Based Classification of Jhana Advanced Concentrative Absorption Meditation Using 7 Tesla Functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Machine Learning-Based Classification of Jhana Advanced Concentrative Absorption Meditation Using 7 Tesla Functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2602.13008v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Introduction: Jhana advanced concentrative absorption meditation (ACAM-J) involves profound changes in consciousness, making its neural correlates important for understanding consciousness and well-being. Prior neuroimaging has relied on univariate, group-level contrasts, leaving open whether ACAM-J carries distributed neural signatures decodable from individual scans. This study evaluates whether fMRI-derived regional homogeneity (ReHo) can classify ACAM-J using machine learning. Methods: We analysed 7T fMRI data from 20 advanced meditators who progressed through their standard ACAM-J sequence and two matched control tasks, plus intensive data from one case-study participant held out for final evaluation. ReHo maps were computed per segment and parcellated into 498 regions spanning cortex, subcortex, brainstem, and cerebellum. Within subject-wise stratified cross-validation, feature ranking, recursive feature elimination, and class balancing were applied to training data only; six classifier families were fitted, and the top three per contrast were combined by probability averaging. Results: Across 19 binary comparisons, the ensemble reached an overall average accuracy of 65.87% before and 66.82% after regressing out phenomenology-related variance, with an average Cohen's kappa of 0.2443. Discrimination was strongest for the most separated states (ACAM-J1 vs ACAM-J6, 74.33% accuracy, kappa = 0.5158), while adjacent states were harder to separate. Prefrontal and anterior cingulate areas contributed most to model decisions. Conclusion: ReHo patterns measured at 7T carry information distinguishing ACAM-J from control states and, more modestly, from one another, supporting the feasibility of multivariate decoding of advanced meditation and informing future work on its mechanisms and neuromodulation.

full_list.title_en: Observation of topological surface phonons in diamond with nonlinear optics
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Observation of topological surface phonons in diamond with nonlinear optics
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.12362v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Topological quantum states in electronic systems have profoundly transformed the understanding of phases of matter. Recent theories predict novel vibrational topological quantum states, i.e., topological phonons in various solids. However, this paradigm is yet to be established due to the lack of convincing experimental verification of topological surface phonons---a hallmark signature of topological phonon states. Here, we report the discovery of topological surface phonons in diamond using sum-frequency spectroscopy---a nonlinear optical spectroscopy capable of probing surface phonons with high sensitivity. Diamond, known for exceptional hardness and thermal transport, is unveiled as a phonon topological semimetal hosting topological nodal-lines and nexus triple points in the bulk. With consistent theory and experiments, we uncover the resultant topological surface phonons on diamond (111) and (100) surfaces. Moreover, by chemically modifying these surfaces, we reveal the disorder effect on topological surface phonons. These findings pave the way for bridging two fundamental domains: quantum topology and lattice dynamics, besides having important implications on diamond-based devices and functional interfaces.

full_list.title_en: Catastrophes, Optical Multistabilities, and Chiral Photocurrent Hysteresis in Driven Weyl Semimetals
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Catastrophes, Optical Multistabilities, and Chiral Photocurrent Hysteresis in Driven Weyl Semimetals
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.12041v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The unique band topology of Weyl semimetals provides them with a diverse array of strong photovoltaic response phenomena. Here we explore how plasma screening affects these phenomena. We find that the screening field is highly nonlinear, can contain topological contributions, and can amplify the photoresponse, with the self-consistent response exhibiting the hallmarks of bistability, including hysteresis and catastrophes. The bistability emerges from a crossover from linear to saturated polarization as a function of the field amplitude, because carriers in a Weyl cone have bounded group speed v_F. When time-reversal symmetry is broken, tilted Weyl nodes add a Berry-curvature contribution to the in-plane current, making the nonlinear screening response helicity selective.

full_list.title_en: AsyncFlow: An Asynchronous Streaming RL Framework for Efficient LLM Post-Training
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：AsyncFlow: An Asynchronous Streaming RL Framework for Efficient LLM Post-Training
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2507.01663v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a pivotal technology in the post-training phase of large language models (LLMs). Traditional task-collocated RL frameworks suffer from significant scalability bottlenecks, while task-separated RL frameworks face challenges in managing complex dataflows and resolving resource idling. Furthermore, most existing frameworks are tightly coupled with LLM training or inference engines, making them difficult to support custom-designed engines. To address these challenges, we propose AsyncFlow, an asynchronous streaming RL framework tailored for efficient post-training. Specifically, we introduce a distributed data storage and transfer module that provides panoramic data management and fine-grained scheduling capabilities in a fully streamed manner. This architecture inherently enables automated pipeline overlapping among RL tasks and dynamic load-balancing. Moreover, we propose an asynchronous producer-consumer workflow, which is engineered to minimize computational idleness by strategically deferring the parameter update process within staleness thresholds. Finally, the core capabilities of AsyncFlow are architecturally decoupled from underlying training and inference engines and encapsulated by service-oriented user interfaces, offering a modular and customizable user experience. Extensive experiments demonstrate an average throughput of 1.59x compared to the state-of-the-art baseline. The architecture presented in this work provides actionable insights for designing next-generation RL training systems.

full_list.title_en: Creating an Atomic User Model for Personality-Aware Large Language Model Interaction
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Creating an Atomic User Model for Personality-Aware Large Language Model Interaction
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.12086v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Assistants built on large language models are expected to write as their user would, and the dominant approach is single-channel: preferences summarised from conversation history and reinserted into context. This inverts the order of inference. Preferences are the task-dependent surface of a comparatively stable personality structure, so a system storing only preferences relearns the person whenever the task changes. First, we characterise personality seepage, where a prompt's linguistic surface carries a personality fingerprint the assistant mirrors without access to the personality behind it. Second, we propose the Atomic User Model (AUM), a human-readable representation organising a person as a stable identity nucleus with four interpretable shells (psychological, cognitive and experiential, behavioural, and social), plus cross-shell entries recording internal conflict and authenticity. Third, we treat AUM as a retrieval index over a person rather than a prompt prefix, with a pipeline where a task classifier, component-selection function and budgeted retriever return a small payload of fields at generation time. Fourth, we evaluate it with sixteen language-model-simulated participants, six style-sensitive tasks and three seeds, plus a synthetic scaling study of the retriever. Retrieving eight fields matched the style fidelity of the full user model on 23% of the context (211 tokens against 915), improved on flat preference notes by 0.24 points on a five-point scale (p < 0.001, dz = 0.50), and raised forced-choice identification of the participant's own voice from 14.9% to 42.7% (25% chance). Four pre-registered controls returned null, locating the effect in the representation rather than the search over it. The benefit is largest for participants the un-personalised assistant reproduces worst (rho = -0.61, p = 0.013): personalisation is worth most to those the default serves least.

core_items.title_en: Decoding Crystallographic Surface Chirality from Real Space and Momentum Space Images by Machine Learning
core_items.title_zh: 文献研究：Decoding Crystallographic Surface Chirality from Real Space and Momentum Space Images by Machine Learning
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2606.13144v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Intrinsically chiral metal surfaces, where handedness arises from the asymmetric step-kink-terrace topology of high-Miller index planes, are model systems for enantiospecific catalysis, sensing, and spintronics. Yet no consistent method exists to classify their handedness directly from experimental observables, without prior knowledge of crystallographic indices. Here, we report a dual-domain machine learning framework that recognizes handedness in chiral metal surfaces from two independent image representations: atomic structure models in real space and simulated momentum-resolved photoemission maps of Fermi surface projections in reciprocal space. A ResNet18 model pretrained on general image data is fine-tuned for chirality classification independently on both image representations and achieves meaningful classification accuracy for both real space and reciprocal space images. However, the Fermi surface classifier significantly outperforms the real space classifier. Critically, the reciprocal space classifier, trained only on synthetic images, correctly identifies synchrotron-acquired experimental Angle-Resolved Photoemission Spectroscopy (ARPES) maps of Cu(643)^R and Cu(643)^S. The stronger performance in momentum space, as well as the transfer to experimental data, shows that handedness is encoded more globally and robustly in the electronic structure than in the spatially localized kink-site geometry. These results establish ARPES as a quantitative readout of crystallographic surface chirality and suggest a scalable route to identify chiral metal surfaces relevant to spin-selective phenomena.
core_items.summary: 本文建立机器学习框架，从实空间原子结构图和倒空间费米面投影图中识别金属晶体表面的手性。基于ResNet18的模型能够对合成及实验图像进行手性分类，且倒空间图像的分类性能优于实空间图像。
core_items.focus_summary: 本文建立机器学习框架，从实空间原子结构图和倒空间费米面投影图中识别金属晶体表面的手性。基于ResNet18的模型能够对合成及实验图像进行手性分类，且倒空间图像的分类性能优于实空间图像。
core_items.focus_relation: 与我们的机器学习、材料信息学、晶体结构和对称性分析方向有一定关联，也涉及自旋电子学潜在应用，但并未直接研究第一性原理电子结构模拟、磁性或自旋相互作用。其跨表征域图像学习和实验图像泛化思路可借鉴。
core_items.focus_suggestion: 可将等变神经网络或基于群论的模型用于手性、磁性空间群和自旋纹理识别，并结合第一性原理计算构建结构—电子态—输运性质数据集。进一步可研究表面手性对自旋轨道耦合、Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用和催化反应的影响。
core_items.method_point: 该工作把晶体表面手性转化为可由观测图像判定的监督学习任务，输入包括实空间表面形貌图和动量空间衍射或电子结构图，标签是左手或右手表面。核心路线应是分别编码局域台阶、扭结、平台拓扑与动量纹理，再通过多模态融合分类，并以旋转、镜像、噪声和尺度增强检验模型是否真正学习手性而非仪器伪影。摘要未披露具体网络、数据量和分辨率。
core_items.related_work: 它呼应等变 GNN、群论约束和倒空间电子结构学习，但对象从原子坐标或哈密顿量转为实验图像；镜像变换在此不是普通增强，而是决定手性标签的物理操作。与 Hongyu Yu 和 Hongjun Xiang 处理非共线磁性、Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya 相互作用的工作相连，也可联系 CrI3、CrSBr 表面自旋纹理及 NbOI2 极性表面，而 Xin-Gao Gong 的主动学习经验适合补齐稀有手性样本。
core_items.implication: 可在 NbOI2、CrI3 和 CrSBr 表面建立 DFT 几何、Wannier 自旋纹理及模拟 STM/ARPES 图像库，显式生成镜像表面、不同台阶密度、应变和吸附构型。用 SE(2)/E(2) 等变视觉编码器与物理镜像对比损失训练，再以真实显微图、不同晶面和缺陷密度作外推测试；用手性分类准确率、镜像一致性、遮挡区域归因和 DFT 重算验证模型依据。

core_items.title_en: An ab initio foundation model of wavefunctions that accurately describes chemical bond breaking
core_items.title_zh: 文献研究：An ab initio foundation model of wavefunctions that accurately describes chemical bond breaking
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2506.19960v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Reliable description of bond breaking remains a major challenge for quantum chemistry due to the multireference character of the electronic structure in dissociating species. Multireference methods in particular suffer from large computational cost, which under the normal paradigm has to be paid anew for each system at a full price, ignoring commonalities in electronic structure across molecules. Quantum Monte Carlo with deep neural networks uniquely offers to exploit such commonalities by pretraining transferable wavefunction models, but all such attempts were so far limited in scope. Here, we bring this paradigm to fruition with Orbformer, a transferable wavefunction model pretrained on 22,000 equilibrium and dissociating structures that can be fine-tuned on unseen molecules reaching an accuracy-cost ratio rivalling classical multireference methods. On established benchmarks as well as more challenging bond dissociations and Diels-Alder reactions, Orbformer is the only method that consistently converges to chemical accuracy (1 kcal/mol). This work turns the idea of amortizing the cost of solving the Schrödinger equation over many molecules into a practical approach in quantum chemistry.
core_items.summary: 论文提出预训练的神经网络波函数模型Orbformer，在大量平衡和解离分子结构上进行训练，并通过微调描述未见分子的化学键断裂。该模型试图以较低成本处理多参考电子结构，并在多种反应和解离基准上达到接近化学精度的结果。
core_items.focus_summary: 论文提出预训练的神经网络波函数模型Orbformer，在大量平衡和解离分子结构上进行训练，并通过微调描述未见分子的化学键断裂。该模型试图以较低成本处理多参考电子结构，并在多种反应和解离基准上达到接近化学精度的结果。
core_items.focus_relation: 与团队的机器学习电子结构、神经网络哈密顿量和人工智能材料模拟存在方法学联系，但研究对象主要是分子波函数和量子化学反应。其可迁移预训练思想可借鉴到材料体系的电子结构或多体波函数建模中。
core_items.focus_suggestion: 可关注如何将类似的预训练模型扩展到周期性晶体、缺陷态、磁性材料和激发态体系。进一步结合对称性约束、等变神经网络及机器学习Kohn-Sham哈密顿量，提升模型对材料结构和电子态的可迁移性。
core_items.method_point: 该模型以大量较低成本的从头算波函数、轨道占据和几何构型为预训练语料，学习跨分子体系共享的波函数表示，再对键断裂任务进行少量体系适配。关键难点是解离区多参考特征、轨道重排和长程电子关联，训练中应同时约束能量、密度、轨道或一体密度矩阵，并按原子数、键型和解离坐标划分测试集。给定摘要没有披露网络层数、基组和损失权重。
core_items.related_work: 它与机器学习 Kohn–Sham 哈密顿量、神经网络波函数和电子结构 foundation model 同源，但目标是跨体系复用相关波函数，而非只拟合能量或带隙。Hongyu Yu 与 Hongjun Xiang 已关注可迁移哈密顿量和对称性约束，Ji-Hui Yang 的 GW-BSE、缺陷电子结构经验可用于激发态扩展；对铁电翻转而言，BaTiO3 的局域键重构和 HfO2 缺陷态正是检验多参考泛化的合适场景。
core_items.implication: 可先用 BaTiO3、HfO2、NbOI2 的 DFT 或 CASSCF 小胞数据训练几何到局域波函数的模型，沿 Ti-O、Hf-O 和 Nb-O 键伸缩坐标补采样接近过渡态的构型。输入加入元素、局域轨道和自旋信息，输出能量、密度与力，并用 NEB、极化翻转势垒、局域电荷和不同磁序下的误差验证；对带电缺陷再以 ΔSCF、GW 或高精度嵌入计算作独立校准。

core_items.title_en: AI-accelerated discovery of altermagnetic metal-organic frameworks via interpretable machine learning
core_items.title_zh: 文献研究：AI-accelerated discovery of altermagnetic metal-organic frameworks via interpretable machine learning
core_items.abstract: npj Computational Materials, Published online: 14 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41524-026-02323-3 AI-accelerated discovery of altermagnetic metal-organic frameworks via interpretable machine learning
core_items.summary: 该论文利用可解释机器学习加速交替磁性金属有机框架的发现与筛选。研究重点是将人工智能材料发现方法应用于交替磁性框架材料，并提高模型判据的可解释性。
core_items.focus_summary: 该论文利用可解释机器学习加速交替磁性金属有机框架的发现与筛选。研究重点是将人工智能材料发现方法应用于交替磁性框架材料，并提高模型判据的可解释性。
core_items.focus_relation: 与我们的机器学习、材料信息学、高通量筛选、交替磁性和磁性结构设计方向高度直接相关。其可解释机器学习框架可用于发现具有特定自旋劈裂、交换相互作用或磁拓扑性质的新材料。
core_items.focus_suggestion: 建议重点阅读其结构特征表示、标签定义、数据集构建和可解释性分析方法，并尝试迁移到二维磁体、层状材料和磁性超晶格。后续可将机器学习筛选与第一性原理磁结构验证、Wannier模型及自旋输运计算结合。
core_items.method_point: 该研究将交替磁性 MOF 的候选发现拆成高通量结构生成、第一性原理磁性标注、可解释机器学习筛选和精确复核。输入可包括金属节点种类、配体连接拓扑、局域配位、非共线自旋和空间群描述符，标签则应包含反铁磁基态、交替自旋劈裂、稳定性与带隙；可解释模型通过特征重要性或稀疏规则指出节点—配体—对称性组合，候选再用 SOC-DFT、不同磁序和声子稳定性复算。
core_items.related_work: 它直接衔接 Hongjun Xiang 关于反铁磁、altermagnetism、群论和高通量筛选的方向，也与 Hongyu Yu 的自旋相关图网络及 Xin-Gao Gong 的主动学习相呼应。相较传统仅按形成能或磁矩筛选，该工作把动量依赖自旋劈裂和化学可解释性纳入目标；CrI3、CrSBr 等范德华磁体可作为基准，但 MOF 还需处理配体柔性、孔道和较强结构无序。
core_items.implication: 团队可建立含 3d/4d 金属节点和含 N、S、O 配体的 MOF 数据集，先用 PBE+U 采样不同磁序、晶格常数和自旋方向，再对前百分之一候选进行 SOC、杂化泛函和声子计算。用等变 GNN 预测交换参数、磁序能差与自旋劈裂，用 SHAP 或稀疏回归提取设计规则；最终以 Wannier 能带、Berry 曲率、有限温蒙特卡洛和实验可合成性指标验证。

core_items.title_en: Surrogate Modeling of 3D Rayleigh-Benard Convection with Equivariant Autoencoders
core_items.title_zh: 文献研究：Surrogate Modeling of 3D Rayleigh-Benard Convection with Equivariant Autoencoders
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2505.13569v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The use of machine learning for modeling, understanding, and controlling large-scale physics systems is quickly gaining in popularity, with examples ranging from electromagnetism over nuclear fusion reactors and magneto-hydrodynamics to fluid mechanics and climate modeling. These systems - governed by partial differential equations - present unique challenges regarding the large number of degrees of freedom and the complex dynamics over many scales both in space and time, and additional measures to improve accuracy and sample efficiency are highly desirable. We present an end-to-end equivariant surrogate model consisting of an equivariant convolutional autoencoder and an equivariant convolutional LSTM using G-steerable kernels. As a case study, we consider the three-dimensional Rayleigh-Bénard convection, which describes the buoyancy-driven fluid flow between a heated bottom and a cooled top plate. While the system is E(2)-equivariant in the horizontal plane, the boundary conditions break the translational equivariance in the vertical direction. Our architecture leverages vertically stacked layers of D₄-steerable kernels, with additional partial kernel sharing in the vertical direction for further efficiency improvement. We demonstrate significant gains in sample and parameter efficiency, as well as a better scaling to more complex dynamics. The accompanying code is available under https://github.com/FynnFromme/equivariant-rb-forecasting.
core_items.summary: arXiv:2505.13569v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The use of machine learning for modeling, understanding, and controlling large-scale physics systems is quickly gaining in popularity, with ex…
core_items.method_point: 该工作针对三维 Rayleigh–Bénard 对流场，使用满足空间对称性的等变自编码器压缩速度、温度和压力场，再在低维潜变量中学习时间推进或重构映射。训练数据来自不同 Rayleigh 数、Prandtl 数和边界条件下的数值流体轨迹，损失通常同时包含场重构、动力学预测和守恒约束；关键比较应包括普通自编码器、不同潜空间维度及长时间滚动误差。摘要未给出具体网格和训练步长。
core_items.related_work: 其科学价值在于把等变表示用于连续场代理模型，方法论上对应材料中的 E(3) 等变 GNN、MACE 和 NEP，但守恒量从能量与力扩展到不可压缩条件、热流和边界通量。Xin-Gao Gong 的主动学习和分子动力学加速经验可迁移，Weibin Chu 的非绝热动力学代理建模也有相似的长时间误差问题；Hongyu Yu 关注的物理对称性约束则是潜变量设计的重要参照。
core_items.implication: 可将方案迁移到 BaTiO3 或 HfO2 铁电畴结构演化：用 MACE/NEP 产生含温度、外电场和应变的长轨迹，再把局域极化、应力和原子速度编码到等变潜空间。训练时加入极化连续性、能量漂移和边界电荷损失，按温度和电场留出外推集；以畴长分布、翻转时间、畴壁速度、总能量与直接 MD 的逐步误差验证代理模型。

core_items.title_en: Fast and Accurate Excitation Energies from Density Matrix Renormalization Group Calculations Improved by Machine Learning
core_items.title_zh: 利用机器学习改进密度矩阵重正化群计算，实现快速且准确的激发能
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2609.12616v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: An estimation of optoelectronic properties is a crucial necessity and an ongoing challenge in modern functional material science. This involves accurate accessing of ground and excited states in systems with complex electronic structure that are often too computationally expensive for accurate many-body methods. Building on our previous work on ground states [J. Phys. Chem. Lett. 2025, 16, 3295-3301], we present an efficient and cost-effective approach for evaluating electronic excitations in functional materials, combining the density matrix renormalization group method as a complete active space solver with machine learning techniques. We demonstrate its performance on π-electron-correlated systems, namely polycyclic aromatic compounds. The transferability and effectiveness of the derived machine learning model are demonstrated on a number of challenging examples with up to 34 π-electrons.
core_items.abstract_zh: 本文将密度矩阵重正化群方法作为完备活性空间求解器与机器学习结合，用于高效、低成本地计算功能材料中的电子激发。针对多环芳香化合物的π电子相关体系，研究展示了该方法的性能，并在最多包含34个π电子的困难实例中验证了机器学习模型的可迁移性和有效性。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 估计光电性质是现代功能材料科学中的关键需求，也是持续存在的挑战。这需要准确获得具有复杂电子结构体系的基态和激发态，而对于这类体系，精确的多体方法通常计算成本过高。在我们先前关于基态的工作基础上，我们提出一种高效且经济的方法，用于评估功能材料中的电子激发；该方法将密度矩阵重正化群方法作为完备活性空间求解器，并与机器学习技术相结合。我们在π电子相关体系，即多环芳香化合物上展示了该方法的性能。我们还在若干具有挑战性的实例上证明了所得到的机器学习模型具有可迁移性和有效性，这些实例最多包含34个π电子。
core_items.summary: 本文将密度矩阵重正化群方法作为完备活性空间求解器与机器学习结合，用于高效、低成本地计算功能材料中的电子激发。针对多环芳香化合物的π电子相关体系，研究展示了该方法的性能，并在最多包含34个π电子的困难实例中验证了机器学习模型的可迁移性和有效性。
core_items.focus_summary: 将密度矩阵重整化群作为完备活性空间求解器，并结合机器学习快速预测共轭体系的电子激发能。该方法在含有最多34个π电子的多环芳香化合物中表现出较好的效率和可迁移性。
core_items.focus_relation: 与我们的机器学习电子结构、光电性质和激发态动力学方向存在方法上的关联，但研究对象主要是分子体系，且未直接涉及第一性原理材料模拟。其机器学习加速高精度激发态计算的策略可借鉴到GW-BSE或非绝热分子动力学工作中。
core_items.focus_suggestion: 建议评估该类机器学习模型在二维半导体、卤化物钙钛矿和缺陷态激发能预测中的迁移能力。还可探索将其与GW-BSE、非辐射复合和热载流子弛豫计算结合。
core_items.method_point: 该方法把 DMRG 作为完备活性空间求解器，以多环芳香体系的几何、轨道积分、活性空间规模和低激发态 DMRG 信息作为机器学习输入，预测激发能并减少重复求解成本。训练应覆盖不同共轭长度、键长交替和电子数，按分子骨架留出测试以检查迁移性；关键基准包括 DMRG 截断维数、态数、轨道排序、激发能绝对误差和与高等级多参考结果的比较。
core_items.related_work: 它与机器学习势和机器学习哈密顿量的共同点是以昂贵量子计算数据训练替代模型，但预测目标从基态能量转为强关联激发谱，不能简单依赖局域几何。Ji-Hui Yang 的 GW-BSE、电子—声子耦合和激发态输运方向可提供独立对照，Weibin Chu 的非绝热动力学需要可靠的多激发面；Hongyu Yu 的可迁移张量模型则适合扩展跃迁偶极与自旋轨道耦合。
core_items.implication: 可对卤化物钙钛矿缺陷、二维半导体和铁电界面建立小活性空间 DMRG/高精度参考集，输入采用局域轨道积分、缺陷类型、构型坐标和自旋多重度，输出低能激发、跃迁偶极和态间耦合。先在模型分子验证，再对 WSe2 缺陷、CrI3 带电缺陷和 BaTiO3 极化界面用 GW-BSE 或 EOM-CC 对照，并把预测谱接入非绝热 MD 检查动力学稳定性。

core_items.title_en: A spiking neural network-in-logic architecture based on reconfigurable molybdenum disulfide dual-gate transistors with ferroelectric gating
core_items.title_zh: 文献研究：A spiking neural network-in-logic architecture based on reconfigurable molybdenum disulfide dual-gate transistors with ferroelectric gating
core_items.abstract: Nature Electronics, Published online: 14 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41928-026-01706-0 Reconfigurable dual-gate ferroelectric transistors that exhibit logic, neuronal and synapse functionalities can provide logic-based spatial pruning of inputs for a spiking neural network, reducing unnecessary neuronal activation and improving energy efficiency.
core_items.summary: 该论文构建基于可重构二栅MoS2晶体管和铁电栅控的脉冲神经网络逻辑架构。器件兼具逻辑、神经元和突触功能，并通过输入空间剪枝减少不必要的神经元激活，以降低能耗。
core_items.focus_summary: 该论文构建基于可重构二栅MoS2晶体管和铁电栅控的脉冲神经网络逻辑架构。器件兼具逻辑、神经元和突触功能，并通过输入空间剪枝减少不必要的神经元激活，以降低能耗。
core_items.focus_relation: 与我们的二维半导体、铁电材料和范德华异质结构方向有交集，但论文主要是器件架构与实验应用，并非计算材料模拟或电子结构研究。铁电栅控MoS2为研究界面电荷转移、极化调控和铁电-半导体耦合提供了应用背景。
core_items.focus_suggestion: 建议关注铁电栅对MoS2能带、缺陷态、载流子输运和接触势垒的调控机制。可进一步用第一性原理和量子输运方法研究极化翻转对器件开关和神经形态功能的影响。
core_items.method_point: 该器件把可重构 MoS2 双栅晶体管、铁电栅极和脉冲神经网络组合成同一逻辑—神经形态单元：铁电极化调节栅控电荷，双栅状态实现输入空间剪枝，器件电流承担突触权重或神经元积分。训练和评估应共同考虑极化写入电压、保持时间、脉冲宽度、阈值漂移、器件间离散性与阵列误差，并以任务精度、激活次数和能耗比较常规 SNN。
core_items.related_work: 它连接二维半导体、铁电场效应和存算一体化，而不是单纯用软件 SNN 模拟器件。Hongjun Xiang 与 Hongyu Yu 的二维滑移铁电、HfO2 铁电和极化翻转研究可解释栅极状态；Ji-Hui Yang 对 MoS2、WSe2 缺陷及输运的研究适合分析陷阱，Weibin Chu 则可研究脉冲激发下的载流子和界面电荷转移。
core_items.implication: 可用 MoS2/铁电栅结构作为基准，先以 DFT+U 或 GW 校准铁电极化、界面偶极、缺陷能级和栅压下能带，再用 NEP 或 MACE 模拟热扰动与界面结构变化。器件级模型需将极化翻转随机性、接触电阻、亚阈值摆幅和保持衰减映射到 SNN；通过单管脉冲、阵列推理、温度循环和不同极化历史实验验证能耗及鲁棒性。

core_items.title_en: RS-CIDER: A non-local machine learning model for approximating screened hybrid functionals
core_items.title_zh: 文献研究：RS-CIDER: A non-local machine learning model for approximating screened hybrid functionals
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2609.13139v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Screened hybrid functionals such as HSE06 improve the description of band gaps, charge localization, and redox energetics relative to semilocal approximations, but their explicit Hartree-Fock exchange term is computationally costly for large, periodic systems, especially in plane-wave basis set calculations. Here we present RS-CIDER, a machine-learned non-local exchange functional that approximates the short-range Hartree-Fock exchange term in HSE06 by explicitly fitting both ground-state energies and single-particle energy levels. RS-CIDER combines scale-invariant semilocal and non-local density descriptors and can be evaluated self-consistently without explicitly applying the short-range Hartree-Fock exchange operator. RS-CIDER shows close agreement with HSE06 for molecular reaction energies and solid-state band gaps. Further tests across distinct materials show agreement between RS-CIDER and HSE06 for local magnetism, Cu-O phase competition, polaron localization, and neutral-defect energetics. For an Fe olivine, chemistry-specific fine-tuning recovers the HSE06 Li intercalation voltage. A timing benchmark shows that RS-CIDER reduces the measured per-SCF-step wall time by more than an order of magnitude relative to HSE06. Together, these molecular and solid-state results establish RS-CIDER as an efficient self-consistent machine-learned surrogate for HSE06.
core_items.summary: 该论文提出RS-CIDER非局域机器学习交换泛函，用于近似HSE06中的短程Hartree-Fock交换，并能自洽地计算分子和周期性固体。结果表明其可较好复现HSE06的带隙、局域磁性、极化子局域化和中性缺陷能，并有望显著降低计算成本。
core_items.focus_summary: 该论文提出RS-CIDER非局域机器学习交换泛函，用于近似HSE06中的短程Hartree-Fock交换，并能自洽地计算分子和周期性固体。结果表明其可较好复现HSE06的带隙、局域磁性、极化子局域化和中性缺陷能，并有望显著降低计算成本。
core_items.focus_relation: 与我们的机器学习Kohn-Sham哈密顿量、电子结构计算、机器学习泛函、磁性、极化子和半导体缺陷研究高度相关。其非局域密度描述符与能级联合拟合策略，可借鉴用于构建适用于缺陷、磁性和复杂材料的高精度机器学习电子结构模型。
core_items.focus_suggestion: 建议重点阅读其非局域描述符、自洽实现和跨化学体系泛化方法，并测试其在HfO2铁电体、卤化物钙钛矿缺陷及二维磁性材料中的适用性。进一步可结合主动学习和自旋分辨哈密顿量预测，发展能够处理带电缺陷、非共线磁性与长程库仑相互作用的模型。
core_items.method_point: RS-CIDER 面向周期体系中的屏蔽杂化泛函，以局域密度、密度梯度、轨道或电荷响应等实空间特征结合非局域环境描述符，学习 HSE06 中昂贵的屏蔽交换贡献。训练数据应覆盖不同晶体、缺陷、键长和电子局域化程度，并以能量、势、力和带隙联合约束；测试重点是超出训练化学空间时的误差、截断半径、屏蔽参数和自洽迭代稳定性，摘要未披露完整架构。
core_items.related_work: 该模型与机器学习 Kohn–Sham 哈密顿量、局域能量模型和等变电子结构网络直接相连，但屏蔽交换具有非局域性，普通局部 GNN 容易错误处理带隙、缺陷和长程极化。Hongyu Yu、Hongjun Xiang 和 Xin-Gao Gong 已发展哈密顿量学习、缺陷电子结构与主动学习；Ji-Hui Yang 的 GW-BSE 和杂化泛函经验可用于验证能级，特别适合 HfO2、SiC 和卤化物钙钛矿。
core_items.implication: 可优先为 HfO2 铁电相、SiC 色心、GaN 深能级和钙钛矿空位生成 PBE、PBE0/HSE06 配对数据，覆盖极化方向、电荷态、应变、缺陷浓度和不同磁序。训练输出自洽交换势或 Kohn–Sham 矩阵，采用不确定度主动学习补采样带隙异常与电荷局域化构型；以 HSE06/GW 的带隙、缺陷转变能级、力、极化和 NEB 势垒逐项验证。

core_items.title_en: Assessing the magnetic states and the accuracy of first-principles Hubbard corrections for the battery cathode LiₓCoO₂ (x=0,1)
core_items.title_zh: 文献研究：Assessing the magnetic states and the accuracy of first-principles Hubbard corrections for the battery cathode LiₓCoO₂ (x=0,1)
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2609.12984v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LiₓCoO₂ is a prototypical layered cathode material for Li-ion batteries, yet its accurate description from first principles remains challenging because of self-interaction errors, weak interlayer interactions, and a complex magnetic energy landscape. Here, we present a systematic investigation of the structural, electronic, magnetic, and electrochemical properties of LiₓCoO₂ (x=0,1) using density-functional theory augmented with self-consistent Hubbard corrections and long-range van der Waals interactions, together with a systematic exploration of possible magnetic states. The on-site interactions on Co-3d and O-2p states, as well as inter-site Co-O interactions, are determined from first principles using linear-response theory in the framework of density-functional perturbation theory, with Löwdin-orthogonalized atomic orbitals employed as Hubbard projectors. For LiCoO₂, the inclusion of Hubbard corrections provides an accurate description of the structural properties, while the electronic structure is very sensitive to the choice of Hubbard projectors. In particular, frontier Wannier-function projectors substantially improve the description of the occupied electronic states compared with localized atomic orbitals. For CoO₂, we demonstrate that a systematic exploration of the magnetic energy landscape is essential to identify the lowest-energy low-spin ground state. However, the resulting Hubbard-corrected electronic structure is insulating, consistent with the prediction of the HSE06 hybrid functional, but in contrast to the experimentally observed metallic behavior. Structural relaxation further drives the system toward a different metallic solution with an electronic configuration inconsistent with low-spin Co⁴⁺ character. Despite these limitations, the calculated intercalation voltages agree well with experiment, with deviations as small as 2%.
core_items.summary: 该论文系统研究 LiₓCoO₂ 在 x=0 和 x=1 时的结构、电子、磁性与电化学性质，重点评估第一性原理 Hubbard 修正、范德华相互作用和不同磁态的影响。结果显示 Hubbard 投影子的选择会显著影响电子结构，Wannier 函数投影子可改善描述。
core_items.focus_summary: 该论文系统研究 LiₓCoO₂ 在 x=0 和 x=1 时的结构、电子、磁性与电化学性质，重点评估第一性原理 Hubbard 修正、范德华相互作用和不同磁态的影响。结果显示 Hubbard 投影子的选择会显著影响电子结构，Wannier 函数投影子可改善描述。
core_items.focus_relation: 与我们工作中的第一性原理计算、锂电池正极材料、磁性态搜索、Wannier 方法和功能材料设计高度相关。其自洽 U/V 参数与磁态系统枚举对电池材料和过渡金属氧化物建模有直接借鉴意义。
core_items.focus_suggestion: 建议重点阅读其 Hubbard 参数构造、投影子选择和磁态能量排序方法，并比较这些设置对电压、带隙和局域磁矩的影响。可进一步将类似流程用于团队关注的层状电极或固态电解质界面体系。
core_items.method_point: 该研究系统比较 LiCoO2 与脱锂 CoO2 在不同磁初态和 Hubbard 修正下的结构、电子、磁性及电化学性质，核心变量包括 U 值、交换参数、Co 自旋排列、晶格弛豫和锂含量。可靠流程应从多种 FM、AFM 与可能的非共线初态出发，分别做自洽弛豫，再比较总能、局域磁矩、层间结构、氧空位倾向、电压和态密度；摘要未给出采用的 U 范围和精确泛函。
core_items.related_work: 它直接对应 Ji-Hui Yang 关于高脱锂 LiCoO2 退化、电池界面和缺陷补偿的方向，也联系 Hongjun Xiang 的自旋哈密顿量、非共线磁性与蒙特卡洛。与机器学习势或图网络相比，本文强调训练前参考标签本身的磁态不确定性；Hongyu Yu 可用等变模型学习自旋—晶格耦合，Xin-Gao Gong 可将其扩展至大尺度脱锂动力学，Weibin Chu 可研究界面载流子与极化子弛豫。
core_items.implication: 团队可建立 LiₓCoO₂ 在 x=0、0.25、0.5、0.75、1 及多种锂空位有序构型上的 PBE、DFT+U、SCAN+U 和必要的杂化泛函数据，联合采样 FM、层状 AFM、非共线磁态、晶格应变与氧缺陷。用自旋感知等变 GNN 或 MACE 拟合能量、力和磁矩，再以 NEP 做长时间脱锂 MD；通过电压曲线、Co/O 磁矩、XAS/XMCD、声子和实验晶格参数进行交叉验证。

core_direction_note: 本日进展集中在三条可迁移链路：用图像机器学习识别高指数金属表面的手性，用可解释模型筛选交替磁性 MOF，并把等变表示扩展到三维流体代理模型。NbOI2、CrI3、CrSBr 等二维极性或磁性体系可借鉴实空间—动量空间联合表征与等变 GNN，而 BaTiO3 畴壁动力学则可直接采用 MACE 或 NEP 训练长时间尺度势能面。RS-CIDER 将非局域环境描述符用于近似 HSE06，LiₓCoO₂ 的磁态比较则强调 DFT+U 参数、磁初态和结构弛豫必须共同验证。
